prompt:

Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — goddess (n.女神): A dignified classical female deity statue in a draped robe, a simple golden halo and small laurel wreath, respectful mythological figure.
TOP RIGHT — archaeologist (n.考古学家): An archaeologist kneels at an excavation and carefully brushes earth away from an ancient pottery fragment.
BOTTOM LEFT — Aegean (a.爱琴海的): A simple coastline vignette of calm blue sea, a Greek island white house and an ancient column; Aegean cultural geography cue.
BOTTOM RIGHT — explore (v.考察，勘探): An explorer with backpack and map examines a rocky cave entrance using a torch, careful discovery of unknown terrain.
review_notes: Reviewed classical goddess, pottery excavation, Aegean coastal cue and torch-assisted cave exploration. All silhouettes and anatomy readable; no subject crosses quadrant boundaries.
